scenario.title: Pack over-voltage across its boundary, at several points in the drive -- limit = 83000, expected legal, at 900ms
scenario.description:
Walk the pack-voltage limit from a healthy pack to well over it, landing exactly on the limit and one millivolt above. The limit itself must be legal; the first value above it must fault with OVERVOLT and latch.
Generated from pattern 'threshold-exceeded' by harness/expand.py.
This variant places limit at 83000, which is part of the spread around the boundary of limit = 84000 under a strict comparison.
The expected outcome for this variant is legal.
The stimulus is applied 900ms in, and the test first requires the device to report CLOSED at that instant -- which is what makes this moment a different test from the others in the sweep rather than the same one after a longer wait.
